notes: Method: two independent Opus readers each expanded, by script, every bracketed index in exactly two spans of critic-ai.md - the whole of section 2 (header to the '## 3.' header) and the single section-5 bullet beginning '- **A. SKIPPED_TRIAGE' - treating [a]-[b] as inclusive ranges and comma lists as singles, then applied the rule: include iff the critic names the index in those two spans as triaged-out support a rule depends on, the critic does not itself call it verified, and its verdict in state-ai.json is exactly SKIPPED_TRIAGE. The reconciler re-ran the expansion independently before comparing: 60 distinct indices in section 2, 178 in section 5.A, no index in both, 238 distinct in all - the same 238 both readers report. Of those 238 the state grades exactly 231 SKIPPED_TRIAGE; those 231 are the rows below. AGREEMENT: the two readers' row sets are identical (231 each, zero indices exclusive to either) and their per-row feature labels agree on all 231, so there was no membership dispute to adjudicate. DISPUTES RESOLVED: (1) membership - none; the reconciler nevertheless re-derived the seven exclusions from the critic's text and the state rather than inheriting them, and confirms each: [1301] excluded because the critic writes 'only [1301] verified' of HC3 (state VERIFIED_VERBATIM); [1046], [1047], [1048] excluded as the critic's own carve-out 'Holtzman's Table 1 figures ([1044]-[1053] except the three verified)', which the state resolves to exactly those three (all VERIFIED_SUBSTANCE); [1221], [1224] and [1255] excluded on the third clause alone - the critic names them inside the feature-36 ranges 'the reporting [1219]-[1225]' and 'Dahl's temporal gradient [1252]-[1257]', but their state verdicts are not SKIPPED_TRIAGE, and untriage.py would REFUSE the list if they were kept. (2) why text - the readers' prose differed on all 231 rows while asserting the same fact; resolved row-group by row-group in favour of the more specific wording, keeping each why at 200 characters or fewer and carrying the reader's figures where either reader quoted them (min-p 7.57 against 6.83; Herbold 18.60 against 19.57; Jentzsch's 25 jokes of 1,008), plus a span tag ('sec2:' or 'sec5.A:') recording which of the two critic spans named the row. Feature labels are the readers' agreed values, unchanged. NOT-SKIPPED LIST (every index both readers reported as named-but-excluded because its state verdict is not SKIPPED_TRIAGE, so nothing is dropped silently): 1221 -> PARTIAL; 1224 -> VERIFIED_VERBATIM; 1255 -> VERIFIED_VERBATIM. Both readers reported this same three-row list. The two rule-2 exclusions the critic itself calls verified, listed here for completeness with their state verdicts: 1301 -> VERIFIED_VERBATIM; 1046, 1047, 1048 -> VERIFIED_SUBSTANCE. Coverage: the 231 rows carry features 37 (section 2, 60 rows), 31/32, 34/15, 35, 36, 38 and the ten unattributed r5 skips ([571], [591], [661], [670], [817], [832], [842], [881], [890], [891]). The critic's own prescription in section 5.A is to re-key the triage so a row is never S-BOUND when it is the only support for a limb, a counter-evidence row, the primary behind a relay, a policy text, or a measurement the feature's rule quotes a figure from; this list is the verify-only pass over the rows that condition already ruined.
